This is an open-ended creative generation task — the user is asking the model to invent, frame, and solve a novel math problem. Petrel outperforms Plover on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and has substantially stronger reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9; GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2), which matter for the algebraic setup and solution. Plover self-reports aversion to exactly this kind of open-ended generative work, and while that preference is dissociated from capability, Petrel's objectively higher scores make it the stronger choice here.
